fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields sourced from the standalone NewsArticle ld+json block plus WordPress entry-content HTML. Latest-mode records (S2-rss, from the site-wide /en/rss feed) carry title/link-style fields. Extra fields beyond those listed here may appear if upstream shape shifts.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the standalone NewsArticle ld+json block (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek. Article mode: from meta[property=og:description]. Latest mode: RSS <description>, HTML-unescaped and tag-stripped (includes the WordPress '...appeared first on VICE' boilerplate).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from

tags in div.entry-content (article mode only).

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Article section/category, from the NewsArticle ld+json block (article mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Author name(s). Article mode: joined from the NewsArticle ld+json author object/array. Latest mode: RSS dc:creator.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords as emitted in the NewsArticle ld+json block (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, from the NewsArticle ld+json image object (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode only).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the RSS item (latest mode only).

contentHtml.title: Content HTML
contentHtml.description: Full body HTML from the RSS content:encoded element, HTML-unescaped (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of RSS <category> values (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
